claims.claim: Google added computer use to its Gemini app on macOS so the AI can complete multi-step tasks across local files, desktop apps, and the web.
claims.episode_span: Google just added a feature called “computer use” to its Gemini app on macOS. This means the AI can now move your mouse, open apps, edit files, and browse the web on your behalf while you watch a live preview in the chat window.
claims.source_title: Gemini on Mac can now use your computer
claims.supporting_quote: Google's Gemini app for macOS now has computer use, meaning it can help you "get multi-step tasks done across your local files, desktop apps, and the web," the company says.

claims.claim: ChatGPT added Live Dictation that transcribes speech in real time on web, desktop, and mobile apps.
claims.episode_span: OpenAI added Live Dictation so ChatGPT can turn your spoken words into text in real time instead of waiting for you to finish recording.
claims.source_title: ChatGPT can transcribe as you speak now with Live Dictation
claims.supporting_quote: ChatGPT can receive audio prompts from your microphone faster now with a Live Dictation feature that transcribes as you speak, rather than waiting until you finish recording.

claims.claim: Canva added a toggle that disables all generative AI features including Magic Expand and the image chatbot.
claims.episode_span: Canva added a simple toggle that disables every generative AI tool at once, including Magic Expand and the image-making chatbot.
claims.supporting_quote: Canva will now allow you to turn off its generative AI features. With this change, you can disable the graphic design platform's array of AI tools, such as its AI photo-extending Magic Expand feature, as well as turn off the ability to generate images with its Canva chatbot.
